CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2576 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5. Bus nonce: 4942e7460eab68db29c0ef60597171a3. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5` or `Fix review: blocked 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 4942e7460eab68db29c0ef60597171a3`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2576 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2576-4942e746`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Delta re-verdict for PR #2576 (roster PR-A, branch fix/audit-r10-roster) at head 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5 (verify with git rev-parse of the PR head and stop if it moved). Your predecessor's verdict at fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8 (last 'Fix review: blocked ... body-stale' PR comment) blocked on three body points only: the Null control omitted two changed carry lists (R10-LIVESTATE 8 to 9, R10-UX-HEALTH 5 to 6), the commit paragraph did not name the two appended commits 9dc08aac2 and 23ef06dc6, and the Head section named a stale authored code head. The body was rewritten (handoff-body/audit-r10-roster at d82834d0) and applied to the PR; the head moved only because update_pr.sh merged current origin/main (4b36dc73) in. Verify: (1) the three body points are fixed and every figure the body states re-derives at this head (carry lists differing from main, groups 108, critical depth 11 to 8 via plan_table.py); (2) git diff fe1365f0f992b1d53d79c8e0a1d94804a74f53d8 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5 shows main's own merge and the delivery row only, nothing under dev/programme/rosters/ moved; (3) roster lint gate (brief_lint TOTAL: 0, carry_audit owners no orphan), git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head> clean, check-runs once (pending: say which). Rule 19: every observation carries `Carry: <GROUP>` or `Carry: dismissed <reason of 2+ words>`; verify with python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster over your verdict text. First line `Fix review: merge 1ebbae78756a3802009081f1fd5a1df4918e7ee5` or blocked. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md.
